data.name: Heat Shimmer
data.description: As a free action, you can surround yourself with heat distortion that acts like the blur spell.  Creatures that strike you in melee while you're using this ability are dazzled for 1 round (Fortitude %2 negates).  You may use this ability for %1 rounds per day.  These rounds need not be consecutive.|DomainDesertTimes|DomainDesertDC
